challenge_record.value: 16% base; 20% upside mature incremental after-tax return
challenge_record.basis: Incremental sales/capital fades from 2030 modeled revenue increase/net reinvestment to ROIC/(mature margin * (1-tax)). Growth investment is charged one year ahead.
challenge_record.challenge: 2030 anchor is a forecast, not evidence of realized returns. Marginal return is not total accounting ROIC. Sustaining replacement capex net of depreciation is assumed within net reinvestment.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Production capacity/capex schedules, working capital needs, maintenance costs and realized returns; stress lower efficiency.

challenge_record.value: 3% nominal growth; 25% cash tax; 2041 first stable year
challenge_record.basis: Analyst nominal steady-state choice; 2-4% sensitivity. Positive mature income taxed without unverified NOL credit. Terminal reinvestment = NOPAT * g/ROIC.
challenge_record.challenge: No claim that 3% is a company fact. Reject g >= WACC, nonpositive mature income or reinvestment consuming all NOPAT.
challenge_record.change_evidence: Long-run demand/inflation, sustainable competitive returns and jurisdictional tax evidence.
